title: C1 agent output (c1-booklet-matcher)
description: Section 11/C1 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/c1-booklet-matcher.md's worked output shape (authoritative over the spec's prose per this project's standing precedence rule, spec 0.3): {"verdict": exact_same|not_exact, "option_map": {"A1":"B2",...}|null, "differences":[{"a","b"}]}. The agent file's own universal rule 8 (missing/broken input -> {"error": "..."}) is covered by the second oneOf branch, same pattern as every other agent schema in this build (e.g. schemas/B3.json, schemas/A6.json's sibling agent files).

verdict.description: Agent file 'Allowed values': verdict: exact_same, not_exact. No 'unsure' form is offered for this field in the agent file itself -- the agent is told to answer one or the other; genuine doubt surfaces as a 'not_exact' verdict with the doubtful span listed in differences (per universal rule 7, 'say so in the note field' has no note field here, so a doubtful call is expected to fall to not_exact and let the SCRIPT-side reread/adjudicator chain resolve it).

option_map.description: Required (never omitted) but nullable: non-null exactly when verdict is exact_same (worked example), null when not_exact (agent file's own not_exact example sets option_map: null).

oneOf.description: Maps each A option to the B option with the same content, e.g. {"A1":"B2"}. A full bijection (all four A1-A4 keys, values a permutation of B1-B4) is enforced by scripts/checks/C1.py, not by this shape-only schema, so a partial/malformed map still reaches the check as a diagnosable failure rather than a schema-validation dead end.

differences.description: Exact differing spans from each side (agent file example: {"a": "0.2 m", "b": "2 m"}). Empty when verdict is exact_same; expected non-empty when not_exact (checked, not schema-enforced, since a not_exact verdict with zero differences is a shape-valid but suspicious output -- scripts/checks/C1.py flags it rather than this schema silently accepting it).

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
